text:
margo: Heads-up: planning needs a decision on the 'Priority Lane' offering (low-latency SLA + reserved burst capacity). Want a lean launch checklist we can agree on before tomorrow's PM sync.

dan: Main question: addon SKU vs new tier. Addon easier to introduce, tier simpler for large customers. Need cost model.

beth: I can model both. will show revenue at 30/60/90% utilization and margin impact. also propose an overflow price for priority traffic.

raj: Telemetry gating: require p95 improvement >=20% over baseline, p99 < 300ms under pilot, and prefix cache hit < 65%. Need sample queries.

sophia: Legal: require 30-day cure window and cap credits to 3 months fees. also we insist on a canary run for 72h.

margo: Ops/rollout asks: runbook must include automatic fallback to best-effort lane + customer notification flow. frankops-bot will create a feature-flag in staging once we have doc.

frankops-bot: reminder: feature-flag "priority-lane-v1" scheduled for staging after merge.

dan: tentative gating checklist:
```
- pilots >= 2 (ideally 3)
- pilot run >= 14d
- p95 improvement >= 20%
- p99 < 300ms
- cache_hit_rate < 65% or burst_indicator > 0.5
- pricing model reviewed by finance
- contract template approved by legal
- runbook + rollback tested in staging
```

beth: I'll post the pricing sketches by tomorrow AM. dan/beth to pair on the customer one-pager.

raj: I'll run the telemetry today and tag results in #eng-metrics. please @me on the gating PR.

sophia: I'll post the contract excerpt here shortly. we require observability addon opt-in for SLA-level tracing.

margo: Great. final call at tomorrow PM sync. bring numbers + PRs. :thumbsup:
